summary.rule: trunk k <- K3 MoE layers [1 + floor(M k / N), 1 + floor(M (k+1) / N)); dense layer 0 -> nowhere

right.from: estate canonical sha256 over the body minus the seal

checks.check: taps evidence manifest == boundary_map evidence manifest

left.from: taps_receipt.evidence.manifest_sha256 (file sha256, verified against the manifest on disk)

trunk_tap_contract: L{k:02d}/ffn_input_rows.safetensors | held_rows.safetensors with rows under one of ['normed']; positions from held_positions (flat row*T+pos into the Qwen evidence ids, row order == boundary_map row_index) or positions [rows,2], else replayed from taps_receipt.json + the evidence manifest (run_omni_frozen_review selection rule); file sha256 checked against taps_receipt.layers[].sha256 when recorded

replay.rule: run_omni_frozen_review: sequences sorted by descending length into micro-batches; every stride-th valid token in row-major order under one global counter; rows concatenated over batches

ridge_held.source: held rows only; None when no layer had a holdout

gate.rule: min(unique trunk tokens, min paired rows over the pool's K3 layers) >= --min-paired-rows

ridge.convention: y_hat = x_k3 @ C_in + C_in_bias; x_hat = y_trunk @ C_out + C_out_bias

notes.rule: fit-row means folded into the biases: y_hat = (x - mean_x) C_in + mean_y; x_hat = (y - mean_y) C_out + mean_x
notes.control: orthonormal chart of the centred K3 fit rows; C_out = C_in^T; C_in_bias = -mean_x C_in, C_out_bias = mean_x so the round-trip keeps the mean component; the forward score is a control, only the round-trip is meaningful

notes.rule: fit-row means folded into the biases: y_hat = (x - mean_x) C_in + mean_y; x_hat = (y - mean_y) C_out + mean_x
notes.control: orthonormal chart of the centred K3 fit rows; C_out = C_in^T; C_in_bias = -mean_x C_in, C_out_bias = mean_x so the round-trip keeps the mean component; the forward score is a control, only the round-trip is meaningful

svd.convention: y_hat = x_k3 @ C_in + C_in_bias; x_hat = y_trunk @ C_out + C_out_bias

notes.mode: Procrustes in the K3-side SVD chart
notes.rule: fit-row means folded into the biases: y_hat = (x - mean_x) C_in + mean_y; x_hat = (y - mean_y) C_out + mean_x

procrustes.convention: y_hat = x_k3 @ C_in + C_in_bias; x_hat = y_trunk @ C_out + C_out_bias

reuse.reason: layer.json + arm files verified by sha256; inputs and fit signature unchanged

note: diagnostic numbers only: cos 0.97 with zero functional transfer is the field's warning; the chart's worth is read in S5's veto / energy numbers (run-book S4). The run book's '>= 4,096 rows is over-determined' line is false at 7,168 wide: see ridge_regime per layer.
